Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Plagues & Pestilence
Module.Description: An original bilingual disease library for PF2E Affliction Forge with semantic Creature Forge tags.
Module.LibraryDescription: Original diseases for wilderness, cities, monsters, and planar threats, fully tagged for semantic Creature Forge assignment.
Module.SyncFailed: Plagues & Pestilence could not synchronize its library. See console.

marsh-rash.Name: Marsh Rash
marsh-rash.Description: A weeping rash caused by prolonged contact with warm, brackish water. The skin swells, itches, and gradually stiffens.

Stage1.Name: Itching
Stage1.Description: The skin burns and itches. You are clumsy 1.

Stage2.Name: Swollen Skin
Stage2.Description: Swelling hinders fine movement. You are clumsy 2.

Stage3.Name: Cracked Skin
Stage3.Description: Inflamed skin splits with movement. You are clumsy 2 and sickened 1.

ratbite-fever.Name: Ratbite Fever
ratbite-fever.Description: A feverish wound infection most often spread by the bites of diseased rats and other scavengers.

Stage1.Name: Wound Fever
Stage1.Description: The bite swells. You are sickened 1.

Stage2.Name: Shaking Fever
Stage2.Description: Fever and shaking weaken you. You are sickened 1 and enfeebled 1.

Stage3.Name: Blood Fever
Stage3.Description: The fever spreads through the body. You are sickened 2 and enfeebled 1.

redwater-fever.Name: Redwater Fever
redwater-fever.Description: Minute organisms in fouled fresh water tint sweat and urine red while causing violent abdominal cramps.

Stage1.Name: Cramps
Stage1.Description: You suffer abdominal cramps and are sickened 1.

Stage2.Name: Fever
Stage2.Description: High fever sets in. You are sickened 2 and drained 1.

Stage3.Name: Dehydration
Stage3.Description: The body rapidly loses fluid. You are sickened 2 and drained 2.

lantern-moth-ague.Name: Lantern Moth Ague
lantern-moth-ague.Description: Dusty scales shed by certain luminous moths cause fever and agonizing sensitivity to light.

Stage1.Name: Light Sensitivity
Stage1.Description: Your eyes water and burn. You are dazzled.

Stage2.Name: Fever-Light
Stage2.Description: Light becomes painful. You are dazzled and sickened 1.

Stage3.Name: Blind Fever
Stage3.Description: Your swollen eyes close. You are blinded and sickened 1.

ash-cough.Name: Ash Cough
ash-cough.Description: Fine mineral spores and ash lodge deep in the lungs. The dry cough can break even the most focused action.

Stage1.Name: Dry Cough
Stage1.Description: You cough frequently and are sickened 1.

Stage2.Name: Coughing Fits
Stage2.Description: You are sickened 1. Before an action with the concentrate trait, attempt a DC 5 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Ash Lung
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2. Concentrating requires a DC 10 flat check, and you cannot speak.

thorn-blight.Name: Thorn Blight
thorn-blight.Description: Microscopic plant splinters take root in open wounds. Dark veins spread from the injury and stiffen muscles and joints.

Stage3.Name: Root-Stiffness
Stage3.Description: You are enfeebled 2 and clumsy 2.

salt-lung.Name: Salt Lung
salt-lung.Description: A white crystalline growth forms in the airways of sailors and coast dwellers who inhale tainted sea spray.

Stage3.Name: Salt Crust
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2 and enfeebled 1 and cannot speak.

frost-vein.Name: Frost Vein
frost-vein.Description: Blue lines creep beneath the skin as the disease steals warmth, as though the victim’s blood itself were turning to ice.

Stage2.Name: Icy Blood
Stage2.Description: You are clumsy 2 and take 1d6 cold damage.

Stage3.Name: Frost Stiffness
Stage3.Description: You are clumsy 3 and slowed 1.

blackroot-rot.Name: Blackroot Rot
blackroot-rot.Description: Threadlike black fungal roots grow along injured tissue and feed on the strength of their host.

Stage3.Name: Flesh Rot
Stage3.Description: You are enfeebled 2 and drained 2. Hit point damage from this stage cannot be healed until the disease ends.

carrion-fever.Name: Carrion Fever
carrion-fever.Description: Bacteria from rotting flesh cause a raging fever. Scavengers often carry the disease in their mouths.

Stage3.Name: Delirium
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2 and stupefied 2.

mirelung.Name: Mirelung
mirelung.Description: Dark mucus settles in the lungs and smells of rotten peat. Each breath grows harder until even movement becomes exhausting.

Stage3.Name: Mire Breath
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, fatigued, and slowed 1.

sporewake.Name: Sporewake
sporewake.Description: Invisible fungal spores germinate in the sinuses and release paralytic compounds in recurring waves.

Stage3.Name: Spore Surges
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2 and stupefied 2. In addition, the disease deals 1d6 poison damage every 6 hours.

sewer-crown.Name: Sewer Crown
sewer-crown.Description: Painful ring-shaped swellings form around the neck and temples. The disease thrives in densely populated sewer systems.

Stage3.Name: Cranial Pressure
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, stupefied 3, and slowed 1.

glassblood.Name: Glassblood
glassblood.Description: An arcane infection makes blood vessels brittle and translucent. Under strain they split like fine glass fibers.

Stage2.Name: Glass Veins
Stage2.Description: You are drained 1 and take 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

Stage3.Name: Splintered Blood
Stage3.Description: You are drained 2 and take 2d6 persistent bleed damage.

dreamscar-fever.Name: Dreamscar Fever
dreamscar-fever.Description: The disease attacks sleep first. Wounds suffered in dreams appear as pale scars on the body and leave real exhaustion behind.

Stage3.Name: Waking Dream
Stage3.Description: You are stupefied 2 and frightened 2.

ember-pox.Name: Ember Pox
ember-pox.Description: Glowing pustules form beneath the skin and burst in tiny sprays of sparks. Fever and heat intensify with each stage.

Stage1.Name: Ember Spots
Stage1.Description: You are sickened 1 and take 1d6 fire damage.

Stage2.Name: Fire Fever
Stage2.Description: You are sickened 2 and take 2d6 fire damage.

Stage3.Name: Sparking Skin
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, enfeebled 2, and take 3d6 fire damage.

grave-mold.Name: Grave Mold
grave-mold.Description: Ash-gray mold grows on corpses, crypt walls, and eventually living tissue. It feeds on warmth and vitality.

Stage2.Name: Cold Mold
Stage2.Description: You are drained 2 and take 2d6 void damage.

Stage3.Name: Grave Chill
Stage3.Description: You are drained 2, slowed 1, and take 3d6 void damage.

hollow-fever.Name: Hollow Fever
hollow-fever.Description: Pale parasites nest in the digestive organs and consume the host from within, leaving the abdomen unnaturally hollow.

Stage3.Name: Hollow Body
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, drained 3, and enfeebled 2.

whisperworms.Name: Whisperworms
whisperworms.Description: Threadworms of alien origin migrate to the inner ear and nervous system. Their movements sound like whispered voices to the host.

Stage3.Name: Alien Thoughts
Stage3.Description: You are stupefied 3 and confused.

Stage4.Name: Swarm Mind
Stage4.Description: You are confused and slowed 1; damage does not automatically end the confusion.

rift-ague.Name: Rift Ague
rift-ague.Description: Proximity to unstable planar rifts can uncouple perception from bodily rhythm. Victims experience seconds twice and hours in a single breath.

Stage3.Name: Rift Echo
Stage3.Description: You are stupefied 3, slowed 1, and confused.

crownspore.Name: Crownspore
crownspore.Description: Golden spores push threadlike fruiting bodies through the scalp and neck. In the final stage the fungus attempts to turn its host into a walking spore colony.

Stage3.Name: Mycelial Grip
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, stupefied 3, and slowed 1.

Stage4.Name: Spore Host
Stage4.Description: You are confused, enfeebled 3, and slowed 1.

starfall-sickness.Name: Starfall Sickness
starfall-sickness.Description: Dust from alien meteorites makes skin and bone shimmer with cold light. The body begins to answer to an unknown physics.

Stage3.Name: Star-Bone
Stage3.Description: You are drained 3, clumsy 2, and slowed 1.

worldblight.Name: Worldblight
worldblight.Description: An aggressive mycelium infects flesh, plants, and soil at once. Leaves wilt near the diseased, and dark hyphae sprout from their wounds.

Stage2.Name: Black Mycelium
Stage2.Description: You are enfeebled 3 and drained 2 and take 3d6 void damage. Damage caused by Worldblight cannot be healed until the disease ends.

Stage3.Name: Blighted Body
Stage3.Description: You are enfeebled 3, drained 3, and slowed 1 and take 4d6 void damage. Damage caused by Worldblight cannot be healed until the disease ends.

Stage5.Name: World-Eaten
Stage5.Description: Worldblight consumes the host entirely. This is a death effect.

pale-doom.Name: Pale Doom
pale-doom.Description: A diseased void resonance bleaches skin, voice, and eventually life force itself. Powerful undead and tainted tombs can spread it like a cold shadow.

Stage2.Name: Fading Voice
Stage2.Description: You are drained 2 and enfeebled 2 and cannot speak.

Stage3.Name: Void Chill
Stage3.Description: You are drained 3, slowed 1, and take 4d6 void damage.

Stage4.Name: Pale Stasis
Stage4.Description: You are paralyzed, drained 4, and take 6d6 void damage.

Stage5.Name: Doom
Stage5.Description: The void resonance extinguishes the host’s life force. This is a death effect.

sunscale-fever.Name: Sunscale Fever
sunscale-fever.Description: An infection spread by desert reptiles dries and scales the skin, making heat painfully difficult to endure.

Stage3.Name: Heat Fever
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, clumsy 2, and fatigued.

reef-rot.Name: Reef Rot
reef-rot.Description: An aggressive saltwater infection turns wounds turquoise and swells the surrounding tissue.

Stage3.Name: Tissue Rot
Stage3.Description: You are sickened 2, clumsy 3, and enfeebled 2.

sky-chill.Name: Sky Chill
sky-chill.Description: A respiratory infection of thin high-altitude air begins with mild shivering and ends in dangerous disorientation.

Stage3.Name: Disorientation
Stage3.Description: You are stupefied 2, slowed 1, and confused.

moonfen-ague.Name: Moonfen Ague
moonfen-ague.Description: A fey fever from mist-choked wetlands makes the diseased dream while awake and follow lights no one else can see.

Stage3.Name: Fen Call
Stage3.Description: You are stupefied 3 and confused.
